camel_example: aliyun dyvmsapi CloudBatchCreateAgent --region cn-hangzhou --EndCno 103 --Cno 100 --AreaCode 010 --EnterpriseId 7000002 --Name '李四' --version 2017-05-25 --method POST --force
description_en: Creates multiple agents in batches. A single batch can contain up to 100 agents
description_zh: 批量新增座席,单次批量创建不能超过100个
name: CloudBatchCreateAgent

parameters.help_en: The ID of the call center
parameters.help_zh: 呼叫中心 id
parameters.name: enterprise_id

parameters.help_en: The starting agent ID. It must be a positive integer consisting of 3 to 10 digits
parameters.help_zh: 开始座席工号；正整数，取值3-10位数字
parameters.name: cno

parameters.help_en: The ending agent ID. It must be a positive integer consisting of 3 to 10 digits. The maximum number of agents that can be created in a single batch is 100
parameters.help_zh: 结束座席工号；正整数，取值3-10位数字，单次批量创建不能超过100个
parameters.name: end_cno

parameters.help_en: The name of the agent. The name must be URL-encoded in UTF-8 format
parameters.help_zh: 座席姓名；需进行UTF-8格式的URLEncode编码
parameters.name: name

parameters.help_en: The area code to which the agent belongs
parameters.help_zh: 座席所属区号
parameters.name: area_code

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether the agent is activated. Valid values:
0: Not activated.
1: Activated.
Default value: 1
parameters.help_zh: 是否激活；取值0或1，取值说明 0：不激活，1激活，默认激活
parameters.name: active

parameters.help_en:
The role of the agent. Valid values:
1: Supervisor.
0: Regular agent.
Default value: 0
parameters.help_zh: 座席权限；取值1或0，取值说明 1：班长席，0：普通座席，默认为0 普通座席
parameters.name: power

parameters.help_en:
The call permissions of the agent. Valid values:
0: Unlimited.
1: Domestic long-distance calls.
2: Domestic local calls.
3: Internal calls.
Default value: 0
parameters.help_zh: 呼叫权限；取值说明 0：无限制，1：国内长途，2：国内本市，3：内部呼叫，默认无限制
parameters.name: call_power

parameters.help_en: The wrap-up time. Unit: seconds. Default value: 10
parameters.help_zh: 整理时间；单位秒数，默认10秒
parameters.name: wrapup

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether outbound calls are allowed. Valid values:
0: Not allowed.
1: Allowed.
Default value: 1
parameters.help_zh: 是否允许外呼；取值说明 0：不允许，1：可以，默认允许
parameters.name: is_ob

parameters.help_en:
The caller ID display rule. Valid values:
1: Default.
2: Random.
3: By area code.
4: Dynamic caller ID.
Default value: 1
parameters.help_zh: 外显规则；取值：1:默认 2:随机 3:按区号 4 动态外显 ，默认值为1
parameters.name: ob_clid_type

parameters.help_en: The pass-through number. You can specify an enterprise trunk number or a configured customer-facing caller ID number. This parameter is required when ObClidType is set to 2 or 3
parameters.help_zh: 透传号码；可传入企业中继号码或设置好的客户侧外显号码，当obClidType值为2或3时必选
parameters.name: ob_clid

parameters.help_en: The caller ID display properties. Example value: {"isMatchCapital":0,"areaCodeRule":1}. When ObClidType is set to 4, isMatchCapital specifies whether to match the provincial capital number. Valid values for isMatchCapital: 1 (yes) and 0 (no). areaCodeRule specifies the area code matching rule. Valid values for areaCodeRule: 1 (agent area code) and 2 (customer number area code)
parameters.help_zh: 外显属性；取值：{"isMatchCapital":0,"areaCodeRule":1}；obClidType=4时，isMatchCapital表示是否匹配省会号码，1是 0否，areaCodeRule表示区号匹配规则，1座席区号 2客户号码区号
parameters.name: ob_clid_property

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to record inbound calls. Valid values:
0: Do not record.
1: Record.
Default value: 1
parameters.help_zh: 呼入是否录音；取值说明 0：不录用，1：录音，默认录音
parameters.name: ib_record

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to record outbound calls. Valid values:
0: Do not record.
1: Record.
Default value: 1
parameters.help_zh: 外呼是否录音；取值说明 0：不录音，1：录音，默认录音
parameters.name: ob_record

parameters.help_en: The IDs of the selected skills. You can specify multiple IDs separated by commas (,). Example: "1,2,3". If you specify SkillIds, you must also specify SkillLevels
parameters.help_zh: 所选的技能id；可选择多个，多个之间使用英文标点逗号间隔.例如:"1,2,3"；传入skillIds时，需要同时传入skillLevels
parameters.name: skill_ids

parameters.help_en: The levels of the selected skills. A smaller value indicates a higher skill level. Specify multiple levels separated by commas (,). The levels correspond to the skill IDs. Example: "5,1,1" indicates that the level for skill ID 1 is 5, the level for skill ID 2 is 1, and the level for skill ID 3 is 1
parameters.help_zh: 所选的技能的等级；值越小技能越高，多个间用英文标点逗号间隔。(与技能id相对应) 例如:"5,1,1"表示技能id为1的等级是5; 技能id为2的等级是1; 技能id为3的等级是1
parameters.name: skill_levels

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to enable automatic speech recognition (ASR) transcription. Valid values:
0: Disabled.
1: Enabled.
Default value: 0
parameters.help_zh: 是否开启ASR转写；取值说明：0：不开启，1：开启，默认不开启
parameters.name: is_asr

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to enable agent quality check. Valid values:
0: Disabled.
1: Enabled.
Default value: 1
parameters.help_zh: 是否开启座席质检；取值说明：0：不开启，1：开启，默认开启
parameters.name: is_quality_check

parameters.help_en:
The return address type for the WebRTC softphone. Valid values:
0: Enterprise default.
1: Public domain name.
2: Leased line domain name.
3: Public IP address.
4: Leased line IP address
parameters.help_zh: webrtc软电话返回地址；取值说明：0：企业默认 1：公网域名 2：专线域名 3：公网IP 4：专线IP
parameters.name: webrtc_url_type

parameters.help_en: The remarks
parameters.help_zh: 备注
parameters.name: comment

Code.description_zh:

Fail.description_en: The number of agents that fail to be created

Other.description_en: The number of agents that are successfully created but fail to bind skills
Other.description_zh: 座席创建成功,绑定技能失败的数量
Other.title_en: 座席创建成功,绑定技能失败的数量
Other.title_zh: 座席创建成功,绑定技能失败的数量

Success.description_en: The number of agents that are successfully created
